title: 有馬記念の後に・昇れ、ペガスス

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road finishes the Arima Kinen, though she wasn't able to compete as well as she'd hoped.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But she will never give up. She smiles as she expresses her intent to work harder than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing this, Admire Vega tells Narita Top Road that she better meet her expectations as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Like stars still visible in midday, the light of this era's four stars shines on.
